E0313

Destructuring target's shape doesn't match the value (S74)

What

Destructuring target's shape doesn't match the value (S74)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0313

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0313: tests/ui/destructure_non_list.stderr.

Error [E0313]: `[ … ]` can only destructure a list, but this is Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/destructure_non_list.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     [a, b] :: 5
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: destructuring with `[ ]` pulls elements out of a list value
 Fix: destructure a list, or bind the whole value with a name
